contracts.signal: Infineon (release): Infineon and ZuriQ deepened their partnership to scale ZuriQ's trapped-ion quantum chips, combining ZuriQ's trapped-ion quantum computing architecture with Infineon's semiconductor manufacturing, advanced packaging and integrated photonics; earlier joint work trapped a 3x3 array of nine individually controlled ions, and Infineon says it is enabling the next generation of trapped-ion quantum processing units.
